items.quote: He sought God during the days of Zechariah, who instructed him in the fear of God.
items.contrast: Uzziah, the person instructed by Zechariah, versus Amaziah, who is mentioned only as Uzziah’s father.
items.reason: The pronoun “him” refers to Uzziah, so the key states the unique recipient correctly. “The instructor” is an avoidable generic stand-in for Zechariah and should be named directly. The question meaningfully tests whether the reader resolves who received Zechariah’s instruction rather than choosing the nearby name Amaziah.
